name: Card

structurePatterns.text: sans body, serif headings, mono meta

colors.hover: border transitions to var(--primary), subtle hover-overlay

pixelVariant.font: Fusion Pixel 11px index, serif title (350), sans 13px body
pixelVariant.shadow: var(--sh-px) 2px 2px 0 #000 hard offset; hover translates (2px,2px) shadow→0
pixelVariant.degrade: without --font-pixel, index falls back to var(--font-mono), still readable

usageHints.whenToUse: Grouping related content: event cards, post previews, feature summaries
usageHints.accessibility: Use semantic headings inside card header
usageHints.doNot: Do not nest interactive cards without clear focus target

doNotInvent: No elevated blur shadow by default

pixelLayer.note: DNA card is the card's pixel-fusion variant (pixelStyle: pixel). Same squared editorial frame but with hard offset shadow + Fusion Pixel index slot. Base card stays shadow-less; only the pixel variant uses var(--sh-px).
